sources.entry: Leed - Leed (for Light Feed) is a Free and minimalist RSS aggregator. AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Leed (short for Light Feed) is a minimalist, self-hosted RSS/ATOM feed aggregator written in PHP, with feeds refreshed by cron jobs.
summary.what_it_does: Leed is a web-based RSS/ATOM reader meant to be installed on your own server. Feed fetching and processing run as a scheduled cron task so the interface loads quickly when you log in. The README says it is responsive and works on desktop, tablet and smartphone. It supports OPML import and export for moving subscriptions to and from other aggregators. Feeds can be updated either by running the PHP action script locally from crontab or by calling it remotely through wget with a synchronization code. The README also mentions a Leed market repository of official plugins. The README is provided in French, English and Spanish.
use_cases: follow blogs and news sites in one place
import or export subscriptions via OPML
read feeds on phone or tablet
schedule background feed updates with cron
how_to_run: Download the project and place it in your web directory (chmod 775, or 0755 on OVH hosting).
Open install.php in your browser (for example your.domain/leed/install.php) and follow the instructions.
Delete install.php after installation for security.
Optional: add a crontab entry, e.g. 0 * * * * cd (...)/leed && php action.php >> logs/cron.log 2>&1
Alternative: call Leed remotely with wget using the synchronization code, as described in the README.
notable: Feed processing happens in a cron job, so the reader itself stays fast
OPML import and export for migrating from other readers
Remote feed refresh via wget with a sync code, or local refresh via the PHP CLI
Official plugin repository called Leed market
Documentation in French, English and Spanish
caveats: Apache is recommended; the README says it is untested on Nginx and other servers
Requires PHP 7.2 minimum and MySQL, so it needs a server with a database
Cron must be set up manually for automatic updates
